{{Quote|Get back aboard the Wanderlust, and keep the engines warm.|[[Daven Tam]] to [[Rostoni]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''''Wanderlust''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that belonged to [[Daven Tam]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] Tam and his partner [[Rostoni]] used it to evacuate Force-sensitive children from the war-torn [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
